chips.docs: Build an agent from my documents

s1.user: Build me an agent that answers HR questions from our policy documents.
s1.need: Great choice. I'll need those policy documents so the agent answers from your facts — not guesses.
s1.got: Got them. Drafting your agent now…
s1.done: Done — your draft is ready. It must pass security review before anyone can hire it.

s2.user: Something's wrong with the workflow I'm building — help me fix it.
s2.ask: I can take a look. Can you share your screen with me so I can see it?
s2.seeing: I can see your screen now. Walk me through what you expected to happen.
s2.denied: No problem — we can do it without the screen. Describe what you see and I'll guide you.

s3.user: Automate my weekly sales report and email it to my team.
s3.plan: On it. I'll connect your data, summarize it with our local AI, and schedule the email.
s3.done: Draft created. The security agent flagged the email step for review — external sends always need a human OK.

generic.reply: Soon I'll build that for you end to end. Today, try one of the suggestions to see what I can do.
